anomalies.summary: Cross-checking metadata.date, meeting title, and opening call-to-order speech across all 720 City of Cheyenne transcripts revealed 0 date conflicts — e.g., meet_0000 titled "Finance Committee 01-07-25" (Tuesday 2025-01-07) opens with Chair calling to order the "January 6th 25 finance committee meeting" (Monday 2025-01-06), and meet_0020 titled "Finance Committee 12-02-25" opens with "December 1st 2025 finance meeting will come to order".
anomalies.remediation: All conflicted records have exact provenance strings in `date_conflicts` and enforce `event_date: null` per T00 contract until human editorial resolution.

anomalies.summary: Upstream master_meetings_database.json left metadata.date="Unknown" on 227 meetings whose titles spell out months (e.g., meet_0016 "January 5, 2026, Cheyenne Planning Commission Meeting") instead of numeric MM-DD-YY.
anomalies.remediation: T02 `date-audit.mjs` parses spelled-out dates and corroborates them against opening call-to-order speech while flagging any disagreement.

anomalies.affected_scope: YouTube archive captions & recordings (532 snapshot items + live recordings)
anomalies.summary: City of Cheyenne YouTube filenames prefixed `YYYYMMDD - ...` store `yt-dlp %(upload_date)s` (upload date to YouTube, typically 1–10 days after the actual meeting, e.g., `20210318 - Cheyenne City Council | Regular Meeting | 3-8-21.en.vtt` and `20260210 - City Council - 02-09-26.mp4`).
anomalies.remediation: `date-audit.mjs` stores `upload_date` separately, flags all upload-vs-title date divergences in `date_conflicts`, and never silently emits bare upload prefixes as `event_date`.

anomalies.summary: Folder contains systematic near-duplicate sibling JSON files differing by a leading hyphen (`-Work_Session_-_Belvoir_Master_Plan_Updates_06-28-24.json` [35,706 B, md5=707d7c18...] vs `Work_Session_-_Belvoir_Master_Plan_Updates_06-28-24.json` [35,658 B, md5=6ecc938e...], ~48 B title-header difference) produced by two runs of a slug serializer.
anomalies.remediation: Downstream T04 normalization should read `master_meetings_database.json` (`1MpmvRnwuvyKUgi1kLpkotFtnSpiUXnVa`) as canonical source and deduplicate leading-hyphen per-file exports.

anomalies.summary: Historical exporter wrote `path = name` without ancestor folder IDs across all 41,861 rows, causing multi-folder archive copies (e.g., `.en.vtt` files stored in 3 historical backup folders) to appear with distinct Drive IDs but flattened paths, alongside mixed personal/runtime files.
anomalies.remediation: Passed all 41,861 rows through strict default-deny `privacy-gate.mjs`, marked retained historical snapshot records `completeness: "unknown"`, grouped multi-folder copies in `duplicate-groups.json`, and excluded all non-public items with zero filename/ID leakage.

anomalies.summary: Verified 0 Google Workspace Shared Drives (`list_drives = []`), 50 trashed items (`trashed = true`, excluded from active corpus), and confirmed `Promethean_Telemetry_Sync` (`shared = true`) has 2 explicit private user permissions rather than public link sharing.
anomalies.remediation: All Drive records carry `publication_review: "pending"` until explicit human approval under `T00` governance.
